title: nan
authors: Misra S.; Sundar K.; Sharma R.; Brink K.
key_contribution: Presents a data-driven navigation framework combining estimation, machine learning, and mixed-integer convex optimization for deployable landmark placement and UV localization in GNSS-denied tunnels.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
